summary: Rows are split among the rank's local GPU workers with CSR delimiters and vector inputs prepared per device. The measured main path enters an OpenMP parallel-for outlined worker; each worker sets its device and for its assigned nonempty partition replays iterations/batch graphs plus remainder launches, then synchronizes its stream. The worker's graph and direct-launch backedges are bounded by the passed iteration count. Each dispatched width 4/8/16/32 kernel covers rows and all CSR entries, reduces and stores. The selected final-sm86 device functions are present.
